description: The attester: client attestations minted for agent instances, and the binding of instance evidence to an instance key.

bound_client.description: The client id that holds the evidence's binding.

bound_jkt.description: The JWK thumbprint of the instance key that holds the evidence's binding.

evidence_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the instance evidence presented.

evidence_type.description: The kind of instance evidence presented.

instance_subject.description: The workload's own subject from its evidence (a SPIFFE id, for one). Never recorded beside agent_id.

presented_jkt.description: The JWK thumbprint of the instance key refused now.

attestation.evidence.conflict.description: The attester was shown instance evidence already bound to another instance key or client, and refused it.
